page.overview:
Who is Gabrelle Brawley?

Gabrelle has brown hair, barely touching her shoulders, with large green eyes and an upturned nose. She has a dusky complexion, and is around 5'5" tall., Gabrelle Brawley}}

She attempts to seduce and win over Logain as an atypical Brown with a sense of pragmatism.

Gabrelle is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability at the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has an ability in Healing. She heals Logain's wounds during the Last Battle.
